relationship_description: Benjamin Abalos is the father of Benjamin Abalos Jr., both prominent figures in the Abalos political dynasty of Mandaluyong.
Benjamin Abalos Jr. is married to Carmelita Abalos, both holding political positions in Mandaluyong.
Carmelita Abalos is the daughter-in-law of Benjamin Abalos, linking two generations of the Abalos dynasty.
